description.value: OEB Breakfast Co. is a chef-driven breakfast and brunch chain founded by classically trained Chef Mauro Martina, emphasizing farm-to-table sourcing and scratch cooking. The Victoria location on Yates Street offers a creative menu spanning eggs Benny, scramblettes, breakfast poutines, and handhelds, with a philosophy of 'learn, teach and inspire' running through each location's design and service. It is a popular urban brunch destination with both dine-in and takeout available, making it a practical fuelling stop for cyclists passing through downtown Victoria.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at eatoeb.com/locations/victoria/ confirms the business is active at 856 Yates St. with matching phone (778.445.3447) and address. The site explicitly lists 'Delivery Takeout' as available service modes, and the menu pages show gluten-friendly/gluten-free substitutions ('Sub gluten-free English muffin', 'gluten-friendly pesto potatoes') alongside vegetarian items (avocado toast, chia seed pudding). No bike parking, washroom details, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open restaurant in downtown Victoria with an active web presence, matching contact details, and dine-in plus takeout service.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu pages show gluten-free and gluten-friendly options ('Sub gluten-free English muffin', 'gluten-friendly pesto potatoes') and multiple vegetarian dishes (avocado toast, chia seed pudding, scramblettes)
